paragraphs.source_en: She took him by the hand, and without taking her eyes off him, gazed at him while she ransacked her mind for the words to say that would keep him.

units.source_en: She took him by the hand, and without taking her eyes off him, gazed at him while she ransacked her mind for the words to say that would keep him.

paragraphs.source_en: “Wait a minute, there’s something I want to say to you,” and taking his broad hand she pressed it on her neck. “Oh, was it right my asking him to dinner?”

paragraphs.source_en: “You did quite right,” he said with a serene smile that showed his even teeth, and he kissed her hand.

units.source_en: “You did quite right,” he said with a serene smile that showed his even teeth, and he kissed her hand.

paragraphs.source_en: “Alexey, you have not changed to me?” she said, pressing his hand in both of hers. “Alexey, I am miserable here. When are we going away?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Soon, soon. You wouldn’t believe how disagreeable our way of living here is to me too,” he said, and he drew away his hand.

paragraphs.source_en: “Well, go, go!” she said in a tone of offense, and she walked quickly away from him.
